Definition
[Adjoint heat kernels and differential Harnack quantities] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0192 ↗ lem:chow-iii-well-chosen-points 1. ch21:21.28–21.32\group Local entropy

Let $H_i$ be the minimal positive fundamental solution of $\Box _i^*H_i=(-\partial _t-\Delta _{g_i}+R_{g_i})H_i=0$, based at $(\bar x_i,\bar t_i)$, normalized by $\int H_i\, d\mu _{g_i(t)}=1$. Write $H_i=(4\pi (\bar t_i-t))^{-n/2}e^{-f_i}$ and define \[ v_i=\bigl[(\bar t_i-t)(R_{g_i}+2\Delta f_i-|\nabla f_i|^2)+f_i-n\bigr]H_i. \] Perelman's differential Harnack estimate gives $v_i\le 0$.
